methods.bootstrap: paired family-equal percentile bootstrap; dependent conditions averaged within family
methods.cost: All acquired spending retained including later decisions and unknown reservations; prefix attribution is a deployment scenario, not campaign invoice savings.
methods.graph: Graph compared with source and inert character padding; character matching is not token matching.
methods.limits: Synthetic tasks and risk weights; no real Skill safety or general injection defense claim.
nulls: goal observations do not improve matched completion
shorter protocols do not improve validity or unconditional coverage
authorization stopping does not reduce actual query work at unchanged completion
risk policy is not Pareto superior
methods.protocol_confounds: Full/batch/next change feedback frequency and output burden as well as schema.
methods.regression: Prior cases and fixed historical 16-loss subset are separate from new families.
methods.stopping: Real prefix interpreter stopping; authorization predicate is sufficient evidence, not globally optimal stopping.
methods.unknown: Proved intrinsic unknown is resolved; unproved budget unknown is unresolved, regardless of displayed label.
methods.validity: First decision and all-stream validity are separate; per-decision denominator is attempted decisions and is adaptive.
methods.work: Query interpreter calls/steps, goal observations, planning, model requests and real calls reported separately; no total CPU claim.

old16_regression.interpretation: Fixed historical loss subset only; separate regression, never new-family evidence.
